name: plumbing-clean
label: Clean
source: Verbatim WSS port of the owner-supplied Lovable project harter_pumping_site_1 (the Harter Custom Pumping 'Dispatch' design: editorial agricultural brutalism - slurry-black, raw cream, signal gold, oxidized copper). Built from the actual project source at token level: every identity string (business name, geography, phone, email, address, maps, coordinates, counties, founding-year claims) is a WSS token or a WSSC-bridged array; the newspaper furniture - utility ticker, issue line, six-layer parallax hero with glassmorphism OPS-INSTRUMENT HUD and annotation pins, gold dispatch ticker, animated liquid-wave SVG, marquee, manifesto with drop cap, three monumental service cards, copper CTA band, annotated technical-reference showcase, field-plate gallery mosaic, the three-tool workshop (Drip Meter, Water Heater Check, seasonal schedule), process timeline, region band with registration-marked map, review cards, FAQ ledger, brutalist quote form and colophon footer - ships exactly as designed, compiled as a static client SPA (TanStack Router route tree running client-side, Vite + Tailwind v4 build).

source_project.port_mode: verbatim source port; TanStack-routes design recompiled as a static client SPA; tokenized identity; WSS content bridge; hero video rung

stack: compiled Vite React (TanStack Router client-side, Tailwind CSS v4) bundle + Anton/Fraunces/Inter/JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts; static hosting, no request-time build
persons_note: The source design's identity - the Harter name, its 1993/32-year heritage ornaments (Est. MCMXCIII, Vol. 32, 'thirty-two years', 'The Harter Family', the Hwy 136 field note, the HCP-DYE fingerprint comment), the Dyersville/Northeast-Iowa geography, the seven-county coverage lists, the septic/manure service copy and the 24/7 dispatch claims - is explicitly donor identity and none of it survives in any shipped byte. Where the furniture required copy, the claim is either a token (CITY, STATE, HERO_HEADLINE), a WSSC-bridged array (areas/services/faqs/reviews), or generic plumbing copy the fleet already proved on live builds.
renders_note: The compiled bundle renders verified services and faqs itself via the window.__WSS_CONTENT__ bridge: services into the home service cards and the /services route tree, faqs into the home LEDGER band. Island areas surface only as footer echoes, so coverage is not claimed: the engine's shared service-area block fills the gap and stays floor-auditable.
photo_slots_note: Eight slots in design order, THE FIRST being the hero-poster slot itself (assets/hero-poster.svg): the falcon-family wiring that brings the donor under lib/mirror-engine/hero-poster.js — the pass re-owns that slot per build (a provenance- and region-gated prospect photograph when one qualifies, the manifest's REAL hero_video.poster photograph — assets/hero-cgi-flagship-Dla_-qtr.jpg, not the drawn placeholder — otherwise) and holds the compile-time ships assertion over it. The four field-plate gallery mosaic images (home Gallery + /projects route) and the three detail plates follow (macro fitting in the hero strip + contact band, brass hands and the CGI render as service-card thumbs + showcase). hero-topo-map and topo-fields are background textures/maps, not slots. On real builds the engine overwrites slots with ownership-gated client photographs. photo_slot_prominence re-ranks the FILL order (owner verdict, 2026-09-01: the client's own photos must appear HIGH, not buried under donor sections): the hero poster slot is the first-second surface, then the hero-strip detail plate renders above the Gallery mosaic, so it takes the next owned photograph; the mosaic follows in design order; donor stock fills every gap from the bottom up.

hero_floor.why: Visual QA round 1, 2026-09-01: the instrument-widget plumbing hero can put H1/subcopy over a busy cinematic gradient before the widget settles. The engine appends the same proven hero contrast floor used by fencing without editing the donor bundle.

hero_note: The donor owns its hero directly: the parallax flagship stage (aurora backplate, topo texture, grid paper, film grain, gradient veils, moving sheen, scanline, registration marks) paints first, the marked <video> reveals above it only when a ladder rung arms. There is no hero_wash manifest entry - the design's own six-layer stack owns the pixels - but hero_floor hardens the copy band.

ladder: the client's own verified clip at client_video_path (engine-placed, mp4, magic-byte verified)

the WSS-owned clip at wss_fallback_clip_path (REAL bytes ship today: the donor-owned monochrome plumbing reel, the 1939853-byte mp4 this donor has always owned, copied from assets/hero.mp4 at re-stage; rung 2 plays on every build as-is)
the design photograph (hero-cgi-flagship, the cinematic layer and the baked-in poster)
the drawn slurry-dark hero composition (aurora + gradients under everything)
hero_video.note: Owner's order: verbatim design, live video rung. The marked <video> carries autoPlay/muted/loop/playsInline/preload=metadata/hidden + the oversized grayscale crop look, sits ABOVE the design's own photograph inside the stage, and reveals only when the ladder runtime in index.html arms a rung whose bytes shipped; an error steps down silently; reduced motion never arms the video rungs (runtime guard plus the display:none CSS on the marked element). The engine writes an approved clip to client_video_path (mp4 only); never a borrowed or fabricated clip.

spa_routes_note: Client-side routes this compiled donor owns (TanStack Router, recompiled as a static SPA). The engine rewrites these to index.html explicitly so a real 404.html can serve every OTHER unmatched path without breaking the donor nav. /projects is new furniture from the verbatim source (the field-plate gallery route).

visual_dna.hero: fixed utility ticker + glass nav over a six-layer parallax flagship stage with glassmorphism OPS-INSTRUMENT HUD, floating annotation pins, gold dispatch ticker and an animated liquid-wave SVG footer
section_rhythm: manifesto magazine spread with drop cap
visual_dna.mobile: single-column conversion path, visible semantic H1, full-width CTAs, no horizontal overflow
visual_dna.motion: hero parallax + HUD sweep + marquees + micro-interactions; fully suppressed for reduced motion

brand_secondary_note: This donor opts in to the client's SECOND logo colour. --brand-secondary defaults to var(--accent-glow) (an unbranded build is unchanged) and --copper is the role that spends it: section eyebrows, step numbers, the full-width CTA band, the hero aurora wash, headline accent italics and form focus borders. Re-porting this donor without the slot silently returns the mirror to black-and-gold.
surface_note: THE SURFACES ARE DERIVED, AND THAT IS THE POINT. --slurry-src is the bare oklch() the brand pass re-hues; --slurry (ink) is a color-mix() of it toward a pure neutral built from the black/white keywords. capture-brand applySurfaceToCss budgets chroma as max(donorC, 0.03+(1-L)*0.06), so ANY bare oklch surface at 12 percent lightness is forced to chroma 0.083 no matter how near-neutral the donor drew it - the amplification that turned every blue-logo client's page indigo-violet. The mix fraction is the saturation dial that formula does not offer. RE-PORTING THIS DONOR AS PLAIN oklch() SURFACES SILENTLY RESTORES THE PURPLE. Verify with a render, not a diff.
accent_contrast_note: The accent is FLOORED on the dark bands (--gold inside .bg-slurry, oklch max(l,0.70)) because one accent has to work on both paper and slurry. The rule uses relative colour syntax directly (browsers without it keep the plain accent rather than a broken value). The engine's injected sections carry their own ceiling.
logo_note: The header mark is sized by HEIGHT (--wss-logo-h, 2.5/2.75/3rem tiers) with a max-width cap, and renders the client logo from LOGO_URL when the engine supplies one, else the BUSINESS_NAME wordmark in the design's display face. NEVER size this logo with transform:scale(): it moves paint and leaves the layout box behind.

lead_endpoint.note: The design's own form mails to EMAIL when verified; the engine's capture-phase lead listener (content-inject) intercepts submit first, and the form still confirms to the user when no email exists.

schema_note: The shell carries a content-free-safe Plumber + FAQPage graph; the ld+json telephone/email properties are NEED-guarded whole (including the comma), areaServed carries CITY and STATE - places, never the business name. No hours are asserted (the source's 24/7 dispatch claim is unverified for clients). The shared content injector adds the richer service/review/FAQ/coverage graph when verified content exists.
truth_law_removals: No source-business service copy, septic/manure trade copy, Dyersville/Northeast-Iowa geography, seven-county lists, source phone/email/address, coordinates, founding-year or family-owner identity, or source image identity is present in shipped markup.
No stock or generated photograph is used as customer work. Only ownership-gated photo slots can reveal.
The planning tools are explicitly general guidance (EPA drip figure, typical water-heater windows, an illustrative seasonal-demand chart) and assert no price, guarantee or booking for the customer.
Reviews render only from verified review payloads and the whole section collapses when none exist.
No free-estimate, same-day, 24/7, licensed/insured or warranty claim is invented; LICENSE renders only when verified.
retirement_history: Retired as an OUTREACH target category alongside roofing on 2026-07-30, unretired 2026-08-04 ('turn on everything'). On 2026-08-17 the hand-sanitised static SPA was replaced by this verbatim source port of the same Lovable design family: identical identity atoms, richer furniture (HUD instrument, annotation pins, tools workshop, CTA bands, gallery mosaic, projects route), WSS content bridge, and the WSS-owned clip re-homed at assets/hero-fallback-plumbing-clean.mp4.

heroVideo.slot: SPA-mounted video[data-hero-video] (the bundle's hero component; the ladder runtime arms the first rung whose bytes shipped) — the donor ships NO static <video>: the photo-first stage is the zero-JS hero (final-qa Class A fix, 2026-09)
heroVideo.note: Video layer exists only when the SPA mounts the marked element AND a ladder rung shipped; the stage photograph serves otherwise. (the donor band wrappers are div.sect blocks, not <section> elements: the library pins this donor to the compiled shape for section reorders — buildSectionCatalog keys on <section>+heading — so the static rebuild keeps its bands as divs with the .sect class carrying the band rhythm.)

engineInjectionPoint: ENGINE INJECTION POINT comment immediately before <footer>

identity.note: Donor-side identity atoms, declared so lib/mirror-engine/scan.js identityScan() builds a non-empty atom list. Never shipped: hydrate.js drops BOILERPLATE.json from the output tree.
